title: 16 Monalea Park, Firhouse, Dublin 24, D24 H3V1
seoTitle: 16 Monalea Park, Firhouse, Dublin 24, D24 H3V1
description:
DNG are delighted to present to the market a substantial family home c.112 sqm in the popular pocket of Firhouse, Number 16 Monalea Park. Presented in superb condition   this extended property has been upgraded throughout and allows a new owner to simply unpack.The bright and spacious accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, guest WC, living room and extended kitchen/dining room. On the first floor there are 3 generous sized bedrooms and a main contemporary family bathroom. Outside to rear enjoys a large sunny facing facing rear garden that is easily maintained. To the front there is a driveway with off street parking. 


Monalea Park is a mature and sought after estate located just off the Firhouse Road. Excellent shopping facilities can be found at Rathfarnham, Dundrum and Nutgrove shopping centres along with various neighbourhood shops nearby. Tymon Park, Marley Park and St Enda's with their excellent recreational facilities and amenities are also located nearby. There is ease of access to the M50 road network and public transport is well catered for with numerous Dublin services travelling to the city centre. 


Early viewing highly recommended.
